subject: revealGate is declared as a SERVER-SIDE guarantee in le-01-cold-horizon and is enforced nowhere
description: PROVEN by Mallory 2026-08-09. config-shared.js:273-276 states the reveal gate is 'Checked SERVER-SIDE against captured evidence, never against a client progress object' and cites scope criterion E1. Every mission 1-4 declares a revealGate with necessaries / corroboratorsRequired / corroboratorFamily. A grep for revealGate, necessaries and corroboratorsRequired across functions/ and _app/ returns ONLY config-shared.js itself. Nothing reads it, server or client. LagrangeEngine.submitFlag checks only boxId plus the submitted string against flag_registry. Neither telemetry.html nor gateway.html disables the Submit button pending any trust-ledger state; submitBtn is live from page load and only toggles disabled during an in-flight request. So a player can type a flag and click Transmit with ZERO independence-test clicks and zero corroboration, on the first frame. This is an integrity gap not a data leak: no flag value is exposed. But anyone holding a flag value from any out-of-band source (leaked key, screenshot, prior cohort, TA) gets full credit including the phase output and the achievement, without ever touching the mechanic the box exists to teach. DECISION NEEDED: implement server-side gate evaluation once so missions 5-15 inherit it, or delete the revealGate field so the config stops claiming a control that does not exist. Deleting is honest; implementing is what criterion E1 promised.
